## testUtils (module functions, not a class)
- **Import:** `playwright/lib/testUtils`
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Methods:**
  - `selectFirstAvailableTimeSlotNextMonth(page)` — waits for `incrementMonth` testid, waits for initial schedule data, clicks `incrementMonth`, waits for `getSchedule` response, clicks first available day (`[data-testid="day"][data-disabled="false"]`), clicks first time slot (`[data-testid="time"]`)
  - `selectSecondAvailableTimeSlotNextMonth(page)` — same as above but selects the second available day
  - `bookEventOnThisPage(page)` — wrapping method: calls `selectFirstAvailableTimeSlotNextMonth` + `bookTimeSlot`, then asserts navigation to `/booking` and `[data-testid=success-page]` visible
  - `bookOptinEvent(page)` — clicks the "Opt in" event-type link then calls `bookEventOnThisPage`
  - `bookFirstEvent(page)` — clicks the first `[data-testid="event-type-link"]` then calls `bookEventOnThisPage`
  - `bookTimeSlot(page, opts?)` — fills name/email/title/attendeePhoneNumber fields, 🌐 network-aware: submits via `confirmBooking`-equivalent flow and asserts status against `/api/book/event` or `/api/book/recurring-event`
  - `confirmBooking(page, url = "/api/book/event")` — 🌐 network-aware: clicks `[data-testid="confirm-book-button"]` and awaits `waitForResponse(url)` via `submitAndWaitForResponse`
  - `confirmReschedule(page, url = "/api/book/event")` — 🌐 network-aware: clicks `[data-testid="confirm-reschedule-button"]`, same pattern as `confirmBooking`
  - `gotoBookingPage(page)` — reads `[data-testid=preview-button]` href and navigates to it, waits for `overlayCalendar=true` in URL
  - `submitAndWaitForResponse(page, url, {action, expectedStatusCode})` — 🌐 network-aware generic submit+correlate helper
  - `expectSlotNotAllowedToBook(page)` — waits for `/slots/isAvailable` response, asserts `[data-testid=slot-not-allowed-to-book]` visible
  - `saveEventType(page)` — 🌐 network-aware: clicks `[data-testid=update-eventtype]`, awaits `/api/trpc/eventTypesHeavy/update?batch=1`
